collapse.name: Collapse
collapse.text: Collapse is the breaking of structure, the descent into pressure.

expand.name: Expand
expand.text: Expand is the release of pressure, the widening of possibility.

fog.name: Fog
fog.text: Fog is uncertainty, drift, and the softening of boundaries.

soil.name: Soil
soil.text: Soil is memory, compost, and the foundation of growth.
